note: Everything the published arm D numbers depend on. `rzp-armd verify` checks all of it and writes nothing. None of this makes the labels independent; see study/ASSESSMENT-armD.md.

decision_path.note: Non-test sources of the scorer's import closure (`go list -deps ./cmd/rzp-armd`), plus cmd/rzp-armd/main.go. internal/storage is absent because it is not in that closure: the scorer's persister is nil.

superseded_decision_paths.reason: internal/policy/policy.go: parseAmountPaise now rejects amounts that strconv accepts but JSON does not (+N, leading zeros). Arm D's corpus uses plain integers only, so all 90 decisions are unchanged and the matrix reproduces exactly.

internal/opauth/opauth.go: Verify now validates the argon2 parameters read from a stored credential before calling argon2.IDKey, which panicked on t=0 and p=0 and would have attempted a 4 TiB allocation for m near uint32 max. opauth is in the scorer's import closure but is only reached through operator grants; the scorer's persister is nil and no refund decision consults it. All 90 decisions and the matrix are unchanged.

internal/mandate/mandate.go now refuses a mandate file carrying more than one JSON value. Load() decoded the first value and ignored the rest, so a second document would have been silently dropped and the authority a reviewer reads would not be the authority enforced. Arm D's 90 mandates each hold exactly one document, so all 90 decisions and the matrix TP 54 FP 17 TN 19 FN 0 are unchanged -- verified by this command before the stamp.
